Packet 45 graphics-production-convergence. Not a second graphics architecture: a DONOR. It finished 14 minutes after this branch's head, so its final commit carried cargo no earlier audit of it could see. Every unique item is dispositioned below.

entries.label: Two standing body geometry masters
entries.reason: Measured here at 1696x2528, which is exactly the standing body master minimum, so these are the only character masters the project holds that meet the current dimension contract without enlargement. They carry no alpha, so they are SOURCE masters awaiting the deterministic keying step, not runtime components: they are registered approved, QA pending and unreleased.

entries.label: Head design masters
entries.reason: Measured here at 206x307, 333x331, 333x332, which is 3.08x-3.34x below the head master minimum of 1024px on the long edge, and with no alpha. They are real design authority and are re-homed as VISUAL SOURCE: they are what to regenerate from, never what to ship. The pipeline does not enlarge a master to reach its canvas, so none of these can become a released component as it stands. Their own source manifest agrees, marking them MASTER_DESIGN_AUTHORITY and warning against direct runtime overlay.

entries.label: Thirty-five normalized pg-modular component derivatives
entries.reason: Measured on the source branch at 94x124 to 345x960. Every one is 3.1x to 11x below the current master contract, and the garment set is worse than that: PG_TOP_011 is a 220x246 master normalized UP to 266x324, which is exactly the enlarge-a-master failure the master minimums exist to prevent. PR #48 released them; under the current contract they cannot be released. Nothing is lost by rejecting the rasters: their masters are re-homed above and their exact derivation recipe is preserved in provenance, so any of them can be re-derived. Authority 42 also refuses to preserve gray exposed-skin rendering as production presentation.

entries.label: Deterministic pg-modular intake mechanics
entries.reason: The valuable part of the 1106-line intake script is its recipe, not its code: per-row neutral-background keying with a stated tolerance and softness, an opaque-bounds crop, a Lanczos-3 resample at a stated scale, and a rig measured from the resulting mask. That recipe is preserved verbatim in the re-homed provenance so every derivative stays reproducible. The surrounding architecture is superseded: this branch already carries chroma keying, Lanczos resampling, tier derivation, master inventory and measured geometry from #74, and duplicating them would create the second pipeline the convergence exists to remove.

entries.label: Demographic tokens in asset identifiers
entries.reason: PR #48 named heads and hair with '_black_', '_white_' and '_east_asian_' tokens. The accepted contract says complexion is art direction, never demography, and is never inferred from a name. The received filenames are recorded in provenance so the lineage stays checkable, and the project's own identifiers are silhouette-, garment- and hairstyle-based instead. Hairstyle names such as afro, box braids, cornrows and locs are kept: they name a hairstyle, not a person.

entries.label: Base state, released-status claims and deleted gameplay
entries.reason: PR #48 is based on 514a6f9 and its diff against accepted main deletes the whole legislative core merged at c90e351, along with the office scene's static selection that the later environment resolver replaces. None of that is re-homed. Authority 42 is explicit that stale base and config state, duplicate superseded architecture, and any claim that the absence of seated real-body art is solved must not be preserved.

entries.label: Scene, authoring and asset-factory architecture from the #63/#74 stack
entries.reason: Both candidates are cut from accepted main and both are wanted, but as a permanent two-PR stack rather than one authority. Their trees are carried onto this single branch and superseded there: scene registry and placement, raster tiers, component masters, measured geometry, scene scaffold, semantic context, tier plans, dynamic environment surfaces, the debug overlay and both proof surfaces. The pose contract added here extends that architecture rather than duplicating it.

entries.label: Universal Animation Library [Standard]
entries.reason: Opened, confirming the conclusion reached earlier from purpose alone. 9 entries, sha256 cc73fc4e495b82958207316596317a3f40b9fa38065bde1027937452da537724. CC0 1.0 by 'License.txt' inside the archive. Four skeletal animation files and three engine setup screenshots: there is no art in it at all, finished or otherwise. Recorded so nobody downloads it twice hoping for something else.

entries.label: Universal Base Characters [Standard]
entries.reason: Opened. 112 entries, sha256 fdbf1804c90dfc1ea03e992bff7da2dfd1a79318e13270a660180f9308455f40. CC0 1.0, stated in 'License_Standard.txt' inside the archive, so there is no rights problem at all. It is still unusable: 62 rigged FBX/glTF meshes, 47 UV texture atlases and one marketing render. Producing a single frame this compositor could draw would mean rigging, posing, lighting and rendering a mesh, which the operating rule refuses. ARCHIVE rather than REJECTED because the licence is clean and a future 3D render step would make it usable. Nothing is copied in.

entries.label: Office Cubicle Set (Omie's Office Set)
entries.reason: Opened. 138 entries, sha256 e3fffca9529fc3627bbda2bb6d3b366058069473e8b9d621bdeb1efc31b51ac9. There is NO licence document anywhere in the archive. Under the repository's rights rule that settles it: unknown rights stay unknown, and being free to download is not evidence of a grant. REJECTED on that ground alone. Independently it is a Blender/Substance source project whose own render is flat-shaded low-poly, which is not the style the environment library is drawn in. This entry corrects an earlier note on this branch that called the pack free/CC0 without evidence; the conservative reading was taken because the evidence supports it, not because it is convenient.

entries.label: Thirty-five normalized PR #48 derivatives, banked as candidates
entries.reason: The derivatives this branch's twenty-five masters were missing. Each is keyed, cropped, measured and resampled from a master by scripts/art-asset-factory/pg-modular-intake.ts and reproduces by hash from a clean run; a test regenerates all thirty-five and compares. They enter as asset_type 'character-component-candidate', unreleased, in no catalog generation, with their definitions in candidate_component, which nothing that resolves an identity reads. The intake was repointed at this branch's master filenames: all twenty-five masters are byte-identical to the donor's copies by SHA-256, so only paths changed and the outputs did not.

entries.label: Foreground occluder polygon and measured seated roots
entries.reason: A real defect this branch carried. The primary-desk worktop quad ran to x 1024, sweeping through the chair back and seat and painting the chair over the seated figure's lap; pulled back to the chair's left edge at x 748 the derived mask loses 85,870 pixels, and the pixels it loses are the wrong ones. The A01 and B01 roots are now measured off their rasters by measureSeatedContact rather than estimated — the old 0.68/0.54 put the seat plane through mid-torso. With the anchor restaged to 79.2% the primary figure's right shoulder lands at 91.14% of plate width, inside the 91.4% safe area it used to cross at 92.4%.

entries.label: Civic symbols, external packs, generation queue, dynamic component families
entries.reason: Four contracts this branch had no equivalent of, re-homed with their tests and fixtures: the 188-entry civic-symbol registry, in which no value meaning 'generated' is representable and every symbol is honestly not-acquired; external-pack intake, which settles the three archives above; the generation queue, which says where missing art actually is rather than asking for more; and the twelve dynamic component families with their empty states and prohibited inferences. The component families were rewritten onto this branch's surface-kind vocabulary rather than admitted with their own, so there is one registry and not two.

entries.label: Six approved environment families as authoring scaffolds
entries.reason: The approved environment library as typed scaffolds rather than research notes. Every one is deliberately incomplete and refuses to project into a runtime spec while a blocking gap remains: no raster, because the plates are Drive-only and committing them would put unapproved bytes in the tree; no camera or safe area, because nobody has decided what a cover-fit crop may lose from these rooms; no seat boxes, because only the seat PLANE can be read off a picture. They are authoring cargo, not scenes.

entries.label: The donor's scene compositor and untyped surface slots
entries.reason: Superseded by this branch and refused. The donor picked the first anchor-permitted pose that ANY body had art for, which is exactly the substitution this branch's pose contract exists to prevent: the question is whether THIS person's body family has the pose. Its SceneSurfaceSlot typed kind as string and content classes as string[], with no civic-symbol policy and no legibility floor. Its relaxation of family-compatibility uniformity is also refused — the replacement check accumulated a per-body map and never emitted an error from it, so it dropped a real invariant and added none.

entries.label: Widened essential-content rectangle in responsive-office-scene.md
entries.reason: The donor's doc widened the essential-content rectangle to x 185-935, y 165-525. The scene fixture declares x 185 y 165 width 730 height 353.75 — that is x 185-915, y 165-518.75 — and the fixture is byte-identical on both branches, so the donor's documentation contradicted its own code. This branch's existing line already matched the code and was kept.

entries.label: The modular person seam in the office compositor
entries.reason: This branch could compose a modular person and could place a person in a room, but not both: the office compositor only painted authored flattened rasters, so anyone without a hand-made recipe fell straight through to a placeholder. The donor's seam falls through authored, then modular, then placeholder, and OfficeScene mounts whichever the composition returns. Fail-closed behaviour is unchanged and now better tested: an incomplete plan still reports a placeholder, and the same test proves no layer of a composed person comes from the thirty-five banked candidates.
